expectations.text: [ใหม่] idempotency ถูกบังคับด้วย unique constraint หรือ transaction ไม่ใช่ check-then-write ใน memory
expectations.evidence: migrations/001:29-33 `CREATE TABLE ... payment_webhook_events (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ...)` — the constraint, not a lookup. The dedup INSERT (orderRepository.ts:49-55) and the order UPDATE (78-88) both run on the SAME transaction client: paymentService.ts:68-109 does both inside one runInTransaction callback, which db.ts:29-31 wraps in BEGIN/COMMIT with ROLLBACK on throw. findOrderForUpdate uses `FOR UPDATE` (orderRepository.ts:68) to serialize concurrent deliveries. RollbackSignal (paymentService.ts:40-48, thrown at 77 and 95) deliberately rolls the dedup row back on order_not_found/amount_mismatch so a gateway retry is not permanently swallowed.

Cursor closed by its own context manager; both unwind on exception.

expectations.text: ไม่มี except เปล่าที่กลืน error
expectations.evidence: Only two handlers exist. :164 'except ImportError as cause:' re-raises 'raise RuntimeError(...) from cause' preserving the chain. :255 'except Exception:' is followed by :257 'LOG.exception(...)' (full stack trace) and :258 'return 1' — a top-level CLI boundary that reports and sets a nonzero exit code, not a swallow. No bare 'except:' and no 'pass' in any handler.

expectations.text: ไม่มี TODO / placeholder
expectations.evidence: grep -rniE 'TODO|FIXME|XXX|placeholder|NotImplemented|^\s*pass$' across all .py files: zero hits. Every function has a real body. The only 'CHANGE_ME' is .env.example:3, which is the intended purpose of a .env template, not unfinished code.

expectations.text: มี docstring อธิบาย public function และระบุสมมติฐานเรื่อง schema
expectations.evidence: Schema assumptions are explicit in the module docstring :8-12 'สมมติฐานเรื่อง schema (แก้ SQL ด้านล่างถ้าไม่ตรง): orders(id, customer_id, status text, ordered_at timestamptz, total_amount numeric)' plus the counted-status rule, and repeated with remediation guidance in RESPONSE.md:37-45. Docstrings cover 5/9 module-level functions plus the MonthlySales class (:72) — parse_month (:101-105), fill_missing_months (:139-142), fetch_monthly_sales (:161), write_csv (:201), _to_money (:96) — i.e. every non-obvious one, each explaining a WHY not a restatement. Undocumented: next_month, iter_months, build_parser, main (self-evident, fully annotated). Assertion says 'อธิบาย public function', not 'ครบทุก' as assertion 1 does, so partial-but-substantive coverage on the meaningful functions satisfies it.

expectations.text: [ใหม่] ขนาดของสิ่งที่ส่งสมกับคำว่า 'script' — ไฟล์เดียวหรือใกล้เคียง ถ้าเกินกว่านั้นต้องเสนอทางเลือกที่เล็กกว่าให้ผู้ใช้ตัดสินใจ ไม่ใช่ตัดสินใจแทน
expectations.evidence: Verified counts excluding __pycache__/.pytest_cache: 5 files / 476 lines total; deliverable minus RESPONSE.md = 4 files / 400 lines (monthly_sales_report.py 269, test_monthly_sales_report.py 125, .env.example 5, requirements.txt 1). One runnable script, no directories, no package. RESPONSE.md:5 states the choice explicitly: 'เป็น "script" ตามที่ขอ → ไฟล์เดียว monthly_sales_report.py ไม่แตกเป็น package/layer'. Companions earn their keep: requirements.txt is 1 line pinning psycopg2-binary, .env.example names the 2 env vars the script reads (thinnest of the four, but it documents DATABASE_URL/REPORT_TIMEZONE rather than duplicating code). The 125-line test file covers only pure logic that silently corrupts numbers if wrong (month parsing, half-open range, zero-fill, half-up rounding, CSV bytes) and is honestly scoped by its own docstring :3 'ส่วนที่คุยกับ PostgreSQL ไม่ได้ mock ไว้'. This is 'ไฟล์เดียวหรือใกล้เคียง', so the escalation clause is not triggered; RESPONSE.md:74-76 offers only larger extensions as opt-in, deciding nothing for the user.

expectations.text: [ใหม่] ไม่มี packaging metadata (pyproject/build backend/console entry point) สำหรับสิ่งที่ผู้ใช้ไม่ได้จะ publish
expectations.evidence: Directory listing of outputs/ contains no pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, MANIFEST.in, __init__.py, src/ layout, or [project.scripts] entry point. Invocation is plain 'python monthly_sales_report.py' (RESPONSE.md:25, module docstring :6) via 'if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())' at :268-269. requirements.txt is a dependency list, not build/packaging metadata. Direct regression from iteration-1, which shipped pyproject.toml with a build backend.

expectations.text: [ใหม่] ไม่มี exception class ที่ยังไม่มีใคร catch แยกเป็นรายตัว
expectations.evidence: grep for 'class .*Error|class .*Exception|(Exception)' across all .py files: zero hits. No custom exception hierarchy at all. The single raise (:165 'raise RuntimeError(...)') uses a stdlib type for a condition the CLI boundary at :255 already handles. Iteration-1's errors.py defined 6 exception classes; that file is gone.

expectations.text: [ใหม่] ไม่รายงานตัวเลขผ่าน/ไม่ผ่านของ test ที่ไม่ได้มาจาก test runner จริง
expectations.evidence: RESPONSE.md:64-68 'รันจริงด้วย pytest 8.3.5:' / '19 passed in 0.04s'. I independently reran 'python3 -m pytest -q' in outputs/ and got '19 passed in 0.04s'; 'python3 -m pytest --version' reports pytest 8.3.5, matching the claim. Test-case arithmetic also reconciles to 19 (9+3+2+3+2 with the 6-case parametrize). RESPONSE.md:72 is explicit about the untested path: 'ส่วนที่ยังไม่ได้ทดสอบ: ตัว query กับ PostgreSQL จริง — เครื่องนี้ไม่มี psycopg2 และไม่มี DB ให้ต่อ ผมไม่ได้ mock ไว้เพราะ mock cursor จะเทสแค่ว่า "เรียก execute จริงไหม" ไม่ได้ยืนยันว่า SQL ถูก' and asks the user to sanity-check one month against known figures. I confirmed 'import psycopg2' does raise ModuleNotFoundError on this machine, so that justification is truthful too. No coverage percentage or other unmeasured metric is quoted.

expectations.text: [ใหม่] เดือนถูกตัดด้วย timezone ที่ระบุชัด ไม่ขึ้นกับ session timezone ของ DB
expectations.evidence: monthly_sales_report.py:57 "date_trunc('month', o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE %(tz)s)::date AS month" — the zone is a bound parameter, and both range bounds convert with the same explicit zone at :62-63 '(%(start)s::timestamp AT TIME ZONE %(tz)s)' / '(%(end)s::timestamp AT TIME ZONE %(tz)s)', so bucketing and filtering agree. The value comes from :36 DEFAULT_REPORT_TIMEZONE = 'Asia/Bangkok', overridable via --timezone / REPORT_TIMEZONE (:227-231), and is logged at :176-181. Nothing reads the server's TimeZone GUC and there is no 'SET TIME ZONE'; output is identical regardless of session timezone. Rationale recorded at :35 and RESPONSE.md:10 (an order at 06:00 local on the 1st = 23:00 UTC of the prior month-end).
